definitions.explanation: Standing out noticeably from the rest; to an especially high degree compared to others.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一際|ひときわ}⟦{目立|めだ}っていた→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一際|ひときわ}⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧。
⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{一際|ひときわ}⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Mt. Fuji, bathed in the sunset, looked especially beautiful.

notes:
{一際|ひときわ} means standing out noticeably from others. It implies a comparison — something is more prominent or intense than its surroundings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一際|ひときわ}⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧: to stand out conspicuously
- {一際|ひときわ}⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧: especially beautiful
- {一際|ひときわ}⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: conspicuously large
- {一際|ひときわ}⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧: to shine especially brightly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦とりわけ→とりわけ：10399_toriwake⟧: especially, in particular (neutral)
- ⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧: especially (everyday)
- {一際|ひときわ} has a more literary, evocative tone and emphasizes visual or sensory prominence.
